about: Server preset for QBCore: the resources stopped on the game client while the capture environment is on, and started again after it. They draw on the screen (qb-hud, chat) or set the weather and the clock (qb-weathersync) or the traffic and NPC density (qb-smallresources, among its small features) every frame, which the capture resource does itself meanwhile. A project can replace the list with its own (server.stopResources in the project file).
name: QBCore
